verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LangGraph persisting state through checkpointers (including a Postgres-backed saver) and stores, and the Agent Server API exposes Threads and Store endpoints. None of it documents an export-all-data capability, open export formats, or an offboarding path. Persistence primitives and API endpoints are developer building blocks a user could use to build an export, not the export capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
